rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Colber provides trust and coordination infrastructure for the agent economy through 27 tools spanning six modules: identity verification, payment coordination, reputation, task delegation, resource access, and dispute resolution. Agents can establish trusted relationships, negotiate service agreements, and coordinate with other agents using cryptographic identity primitives.
